  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.

  A motion was made by Councilmember De Paula, seconded by Councilmember Vargas, to adopt

D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, reminded residents about the upcoming
annual carnival and parade from April 17­19.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, thanked residents who participated in the last block cleanup;
announced that they will hold the next block cleanup on June 27; and that the Earth Day event on April 22
will feature the planting of a live Christmas tree.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember De Paula announced he attended open houses at Furgeson and Hawaiian Elementary
Schools and expressed gratitude to families for their student support.

Mayor Del Rio announced that she attended the yearly Easter Egg Hunt and thanked staff for organizing
it.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:45 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, April 22, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
